data: Station Chetco River is a small-boat station at the Brookings harbor. The home count comes from the Coast Guard's housing map; the station facts come from an undated Coast Guard fact sheet and a Coast Guard news release, both read through search results.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists 14 active homes at the Chetco River housing site.

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
